name: Booked to Done
rules: Backgrounds are white. Text is dark green, never pure black.
Brand green is for buttons, selected states, the logo and key lines.
"Done" green appears only on Auto chips, checkmarks and paid or approved moments.
AI moments always use the purple-to-blue gradient.
Red appears only on the problem X marks.

brandGreen.use: Logo icon, buttons, chat bubbles, selected options, progress bar, email pill, the brand line and its underline

darkGreen.use: Headlines, main text, wordmark, problem words

lightGreen.use: Offset shadows behind phones, cards and the email pill

chipGrey.use: AI chat bubble, empty item chips

doneGreen.use: Auto chips, checkmarks, Paid and Approved callouts

aiPurple.use: Start of the AI gradient (chips, scan line, AI cards)

problemRed.use: The X next to each problem

demoOrange.use: "This is a demo" tag text, on #FFEDD5
